planes.name: Interior Plane
planes.description: The soul's own interior life: what it is like to be this particular soul.

planes.name: Exterior Plane of Shared Reality
planes.description: Time-space: bodies, objects, events and other persons that embodied souls share.

planes.name: Transcendental Plane
planes.description: God-space: the Good and the True, which the soul participates in through apertures but does not inhabit.

plane_roles.description: Operates primarily within the Interior Plane: the soul's core interior machinery.
Grounds the soul in shared reality: its spatiotemporal address.
Draws the border between interior and exterior.
Reaches across the boundary to bond with other beings.
Participates in the Transcendental Plane; the opening through which the Good enters.
Perceives aspects of the Transcendental Plane from within the soul.

categories.name: Substrates
categories.function: What grounds and orients the soul
categories.pairing: The two identities: the register and the participation in the Good

categories.name: Drives
categories.pairing: Gate (Will) and Pull (Desire): assertion and attraction

categories.name: Generators
categories.pairing: Image-making and Symbol-making: internal representation and external communication

categories.name: Sensors
categories.pairing: Qualitative coloring and Direct apprehension: feeling and knowing

categories.name: Regulators
categories.pairing: Moral evaluation and Logical evaluation: right/wrong and valid/invalid

categories.name: Illuminators
categories.pairing: Focused light and Ambient light: the flashlight and the room-glow

categories.name: Binders
categories.pairing: Inward binding (self to experience) and Outward binding (self to others)

categories.name: Matrices
categories.function: Where and when the soul exists
categories.pairing: Body and Time: the existential coordinates of incarnate existence

categories.name: Apprehensions
categories.pairing: The Beautiful and The Holy: perception of transcendental qualities of reality

elements.name: Memory
elements.description: The soul's register: the substrate onto which all experience is written. A passive medium that stores without judging, records without filtering, accumulates without directing. x + 0 = x.

elements.name: Image
elements.description: The soul's participation in the Good (imago Dei): the unified I, the soul's being, and its connection to the source of being. Makes every operation personal without changing it. x × 1 = x. Cannot compound: 1 × 1 = 1.

elements.name: Will
elements.description: The soul's capacity for assertion, agency, and volitional action. Will says yes or no. It commits, refuses, persists, surrenders.

square.description: Will applied to Will. The capacity to sustain volition over time.

elements.name: Desire
elements.description: The soul's motivational pull toward objects. Desire reaches, longs, hungers. Distinct from Will: you can desire what you won't permit (temptation) and will what you don't desire (sacrifice).

square.description: Desire feeding Desire. Self-reinforcing appetitive loops.

elements.name: Imagination
elements.description: The soul's capacity to conceive what is not present or actual. Image-making, scenario-building, counterfactual thinking, fantasy, visualization. The inner theater.

square.description: Imagination imagining its own products. Recursive inner theater.

elements.name: Emotion
elements.description: The soul's qualitative feeling dimension. Affect, mood, the weather of inner experience. The capacity to feel pleasure, pain, joy, grief, fear, anger, love.

square.description: Emotion about Emotion. Anxiety about anxiety, joy about joy.

elements.name: Conscience
elements.description: The soul's reflexive moral witness. Stands apart from one's own states and renders moral judgment. Not the moral standard itself (which flows from the Good through Image) but the faculty that applies the standard.

square.description: Conscience judging Conscience. Moral evaluation of one's own moral evaluation.

elements.name: Attention
elements.description: The soul's selective focus: the aperture that determines what the soul is engaged with. The flashlight of consciousness directed at specific objects.

square.description: Attention attending to its own attending. Attentional lock.

elements.name: Intuition
elements.description: The soul's capacity for direct apprehension: knowing without mediation of reasoning or sensory evidence. Gut feelings, discernment, the sense that something is true or right. Perceives the True.

square.description: Intuition about Intuition. Trusting or distrusting one's own gut.

elements.name: Self-Differentiation
elements.description: The soul's capacity for self-definition and boundary-drawing. Not just 'I am' (that's Image) but 'I am this and not that.' The structural demarcation between self and not-self.

elements.name: Attachment
elements.description: The soul's capacity to form durable, particular bonds to specific other beings, such that another's presence and absence directly affect the soul's functioning.

square.description: Attachment patterns applied to attachment capacity itself. Secure vs. insecure.

elements.name: Reason
elements.description: The soul's capacity for logical analysis, pattern-detection, inference, and structured evaluation. Evaluates propositions for consistency, validity, and coherence. Operates on any content.

square.description: Reasoning about reasoning. Logic examining its own operations.

elements.name: Awareness
elements.description: The soul's ambient, reflexive consciousness: the meta-faculty of knowing that you are experiencing. If Attention is the flashlight, Awareness is the ambient light in the room.

square.description: Awareness aware of Awareness. The witness state.

elements.name: Logos
elements.description: The soul's capacity for symbolic representation: encoding experience into signs, decoding signs into meaning, communicating inner states across the boundary of the self. Language, mathematics, notation.

square.description: Language about language. Grammar, linguistics, formal logic.

elements.name: Embodiment
elements.description: The soul's felt experience of being in and connected to a body. Not the body itself but the soul's interface with the body. The phenomenology of body-inhabitation.

square.description: The body's representation of itself. Proprioceptive self-model.

elements.name: Temporality
elements.description: The soul's experience of time: duration, sequence, flow, before and after, past, present and future. The felt texture of time's passage.

square.description: The experience of experiencing time. Temporal self-awareness.

elements.name: Aesthetic Sense
elements.description: The soul's perception of beauty, harmony, proportion, elegance. Encounters the Good as Beauty.

square.description: Beauty-perception applied to its own products. Cultivated aesthetic judgment.

elements.name: Numinous Sense
elements.description: The soul's perception of holiness, the sacred, transcendence: the mysterium tremendum et fascinans. Encounters the True as Holiness.

square.description: Numinous sensitivity to one's own numinous experiences. Deepening capacity for the sacred.

reality_axes.question: Does this come from the body or the mind?
Is this immediate or mediated by memory or anticipation?
Did I choose to have this experience?
